patch_description:
Proposes a parameter-efficient, interleaved CRX ring plus hub CRY ansatz block. 
Key ideas:
- Split the CRX ring into two interleaved halves (0-1,1-2,2-3,3-4) and (4-5,5-6,6-7,7-0).
- Sandwiched CRY hub gates (center-edge) between the two CRX halves.
- Reuse the same CRX parameter across both ring halves to minimize parameters (crx_ring).
- Use a single hub parameter (cry_hub_edge) shared across all four center-to-edge CRY gates.
- Preserve symmetry-based pre/post-RZ and RY layers to retain the existing structured inductive bias.
- All gates respect the adjacency constraints of GRID_EDGE_SET.

Expected benefits:
- Reduced parameter count (per-block) compared to previous designs, improving sample efficiency.
- Richer two-qubit mixing via CRX–CRY–CRX sequencing, improving expressive power without bloating the parameter space.
- Better generalization and faster convergence for Adam optimization under fixed data/training loop.

The new ANSATZ_SPEC is implemented inside the EVOLVE-BLOCK by redefining _build_hierarchical_ansatz_spec.
